interactions.name: Nightly interest accrual (job INTACR)
interactions.summary: Computes daily interest for every open account and posts it; restartable from the last checkpoint.
outputs: GLEXTRACT (sequential file for the general ledger)

interactions.name: General ledger extract
interactions.summary: Fixed-width file handed to the general ledger system each night.

rules.statement: Daily interest is balance times annual rate divided by 365, rounded half-up to 2 decimals.
Accounts with a negative balance accrue no interest.

int:intacr-job: rule:INT-2 is contradicted: the source accrues interest on negative balances when the overdraft flag is set.
Given a balance of 1000.00 at 3.65%, the daily interest is 0.10.
